# Accelerator

The **Accelerator** is a Claude Code plugin suite that turns a bare project into a governed, production-ready codebase. It ships 34 composable plugins — covering greenfield initialisation, code review, API design, observability, compliance, release management, and more — all wired to a shared `ai-baseline` substrate that provides an audit trail, PII scrub, and cost gate on every agent call.

## ai-baseline dependency

Every `runtime` plugin in this suite declares `requires: ["ai-baseline"]`. Install `ai-baseline` first; it injects the mandatory `baseline-enforcer` skill into every agent, ensuring audit logging, PII scrubbing, and Opus cost-gating are active before any output is emitted.

## Start here

| Goal | Plugin | Entry command |
|------|--------|---------------|
| Start a new project from scratch | greenfield-project-initializer | `/greenfield` |
| Understand an existing codebase | onboarding-guide | `/onboarding` |
| Ongoing development companion | dev-companion | `/review`, `/spec`, `/adr` |
| Spec written — inject production requirements | ai-baseline | `/enrich <spec>` |
| Prepare for release | release-manager | `/release` |
| Manage a multi-repo workspace | workspace-companion | `/workspace-init` |
| Modernize a legacy codebase | legacy-modernizer | `/modernize` |
